title: Frederick, MD — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Frederick, MD: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Frederick is a city in MD with a population of 75,000. Historic city in western Maryland with a charming downtown and proximity to DC. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher.
